notes.contentHtml:
General Education Program Requirements

National University's General Education Program consists of a minimum of 69 quarter (46 semester) units in eight different areas. Of these, at least 4.5 quarter units (3 semester units) must be upper-division courses, and 4.5 quarter units (3 semester units) must focus on diversity-enriched coursework. Students can apply up to 13.5 quarter units (9 semester units) of upper-division coursework towards their general education requirements.

notes.content: The Eight General Education Requirement Areas for a Bachelor's Degree are: Area A – English Communication (minimum 13.5 quarter units [9 semester units] with 1 course from each category) English Composition Advanced English Composition Oral Communication Area B – Mathematical Concepts & Quantitative Reasoning (minimum 4.5 quarter units [3 semester units]) Area C – Information Literacy (minimum 4.5 quarter units [3 semester units]) Area D – Arts, Humanities & Languages (minimum 18 quarter units [12 semester units] in at least 2 categories) Arts Humanities Languages (Students may satisfy Area D Language requirements with 9.0 quarter units [6 semester units] of computer languages) Area E – Social & Behavioral Sciences (minimum 13.5 quarter units [9 semester units]) Area F – Physical & Biological Sciences (minimum 6 quarter units [4 semester units] with one science lab required ) Area G – Lifelong Learning & Self Development (minimum 4.5 quarter units [3 semester units]) Area A-G – General Education (minimum 4.5 quarter units [3 semester units]). Any additional GE course may satisfy this Area.

notes.content: CSU General Education Breadth, IGETC and Cal-GETC National University accepts the following General Education certifications: California State University (CSU) General Education Breadth, the Inter-Segmental General Education Transfer Curriculum (IGETC), or the California General Education Transfer Curriculum (Cal-GETC). All certification requirements for CSU General Education Breadth, IGETC or Cal-GETC must be completed and certified prior to transfer to National University. Partial certifications are not accepted. Students transferring with full certifications are required to take at least one upper-division general education course at National to fulfill the unit requirements. Certain degree programs may require additional upper-division general education courses; refer to specific Major Articulation Agreements for details. Students must submit an official transcript that includes the certification, or a separate certification form from the community college attended. For more information on NU’s General Education program, please see NU’s current catalog .
